relevance_note: Single case report of a man with Danon disease diagnosed histologically: 'A 37-year-old Caucasian man with Danon disease'; no LAMP2 variant is printed or attributed to him.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; one in-scope person (the single unnamed patient, label 'patient' under rule 5). The patient is in scope by diagnosis of Danon disease ('DD was diagnosed on muscle biopsy'; 'histologically confirmed DD'); the paper never states that he was genetically tested or carries a LAMP2 variant (LAMP2 is mentioned only in general background), so the variants table is empty and n_patients_reported (defined as patients with a LAMP2 variant) is null. Table 1 has a caption only, no table body in the Markdown, so its values were not extracted. CME is recorded as observed from the title and conclusion although the Discussion hedges ('strongly suggests' CME; angiography refused). 'Slit-lamp biomicroscopy of the anterior segments was unremarkable' is a normal examination as a whole, recorded as written ('abnormality of the anterior segments') and excludes nothing more specific. Cardiomyopathy was dilated; recorded as observed for the 'dilated or hypokinetic left ventricle' checklist item; heart failure not stated, left not reported despite transplant. 'Peripheral myopathy' counted as skeletal myopathy for the checklist item; proximal weakness itself not stated. Age 37 is age at presentation; treatment follow-up of 48 weeks thereafter. Vital status not stated. No contradictions found. A Python script in scratch assembled the JSON from hand-written values.
